title: Legal Streaming: IPTV Licensing and Copyright
description: What official UK and US copyright guidance says about IPTV, why licensing is the question that matters, and warning signs of an unlicensed service.
intro: IPTV is a way of delivering television. Whether a service is lawful depends on whether it is licensed to send the content. The explainer here summarises official UK and US copyright guidance and lists warning signs of an unlicensed service. It is general information, not legal advice.

faq.question: Is IPTV illegal in the UK?
faq.answer: No. IPTV is a way of delivering television, and licensed broadcasters and streaming services use it. The legal question is whether the content is licensed for the service that sends it. The explainer summarises official UK and US copyright guidance and does not state a separate rule for viewers.
